decisions.reason: The pipe cleaning box for sewers draws on the firm's fluid-handling and utility-sector knowledge, so management can interpret early results and refine it for existing customers.

Public waste bins lie far from the core offer, which limits the firm's ability to learn from early results, but they still use its metal fabrication and coating skills and reach public-sector buyers it already serves, so management keeps them for now while watching them closely.
Ground sleeves for posts build directly on the firm's fabrication and surface-treatment expertise, letting it assimilate customer feedback easily.
Cast iron ground sleeves fit the established product line, although cast iron is somewhat less familiar than steel processing, so the risk of dropping them is slightly higher.
Steel ground sleeves rest squarely on the firm's core steel processing and coating knowledge, making them the easiest to improve and keep.
